spec.description: Anomalias das cozeduras por forno e detalhe de energia e custos (kWh, gás, preço e custo por peça).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT market_kwh_price AS "€/kWh"
FROM public.batch_cost
ORDER BY calculated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

spec.title: Taxa de Defeito: com vs sem Anomalia

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN kf.firing_anomaly THEN 'Com anomalia' ELSE 'Sem anomalia' END AS "Cozedura",
  ROUND((100.0 * SUM(p.broken_pieces) / NULLIF(SUM(p.total_qty),0))::numeric, 2) AS "Taxa de Defeito (%)"
FROM public.kiln_firing kf
JOIN public.firing_batch fb ON kf.firing_id = fb.firing_id
JOIN public.production p ON p.batch_id = fb.batch_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(kf.created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT created_at AS "Data",
  kiln_id AS "Forno",
  max_temp_recorded AS "Temperatura Máx (°C)",
  temp_increase_rate AS "Taxa de Subida",
  CASE WHEN temp_anomaly AND rate_anomaly THEN 'Temperatura + Taxa' WHEN temp_anomaly THEN 'Temperatura' WHEN rate_anomaly THEN 'Taxa de subida' ELSE 'Geral' END AS "Tipo de Anomalia"
FROM public.kiln_firing
WHERE firing_anomaly AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(calculated_at, '1h'),
  SUM(total_kwh_consumed) AS "Energia (kWh)",
  SUM(gas_consumed_m3) AS "Gás (m³)"
FROM public.batch_cost
WHERE $__timeFilter(calculated_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: Custo por Peça ao Longo do Tempo

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(calculated_at, '1h'),
  AVG(energy_cost_per_piece) AS "€/peça"
FROM public.batch_cost
WHERE $__timeFilter(calculated_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(calculated_at, '1h'),
  AVG(market_kwh_price) AS "€/kWh"
FROM public.batch_cost
WHERE $__timeFilter(calculated_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT kiln_id::text AS "Forno",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE temp_anomaly) AS "Temperatura",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rate_anomaly) AS "Taxa de subida"
FROM public.kiln_firing
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: Taxa de Subida de Temperatura por Forno

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'),
  kiln_id::text AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(temp_increase_rate)::numeric, 2) AS value
FROM public.kiln_firing
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: Fornos: Anomalias, Energia & Custos
